descriptions: SNMX-12 Korloy Face Mill Cutter is a high-performance milling solution designed for precision face milling operations in CNC and conventional machining centers. Manufactured using premium-grade alloy steel, this face mill cutter ensures excellent rigidity, long tool life, and superior surface finish, even in heavy-duty cutting applications.

This cutter is compatible with SNMX 1205 / SNMX 12 series carbide inserts, making it ideal for steel, stainless steel, cast iron, and alloy steel machining. Widely used in automotive, aerospace, tool rooms, and heavy engineering industries, the Korloy SNMX-12 face mill delivers consistent performance and high productivity.
